description: Collapsible column groups in the Svelte 5 data grid. Each quarter is a column group with a caret in its header: the quarter Total is always visible and the month columns are tagged columnGroupShow: 'open' so they appear only when the group is expanded. Groups start collapsed, and openByDefault on the first quarter opens it initially.

faq.question: How do I make a column group collapsible?
faq.answer: Define the group with an id and a columns array, and tag the child columns that should hide when collapsed with columnGroupShow: 'open'. The header shows a caret automatically.

faq.question: How do I keep one column visible in both states?
faq.answer: Leave columnGroupShow off that column. The quarter Total here has no tag, so it shows whether the group is open or closed.

faq.question: How do I choose the initial state?
faq.answer: Set openByDefault: true on the group. Groups without it start collapsed.
